leads.title: [HIRING] Shopify tracking + n8n specialist, part-time ongoing, $35/hr guaranteed + revenue share
leads.description: Hi all, I’m Boston. I run Young Automation Studio, a new agency on Upwork. We fix Shopify tracking (Meta Pixel / Conversions API duplicates, GA4 purchases), tune up Klaviyo, and build n8n automations for Shopify stores. From December we add lead-response and CRM automations for service businesses and agencies. We use AI heavily to scope, draft and prototype, so we need an expert to build it right, test it, and be the person clients talk to. What you’d do Deliver 72-hour Tracking Fix Sprints: Meta Pixel + Conversions API de-duplication (event_id), GA4 purchase events from Shopify Customer Events, and cleanup after Shopify retired Additional Scripts. Klaviyo health checks and flow tune-ups (abandoned checkout, browse, post-purchase, winback), plus deliverability basics (SPF, DKIM, DMARC). n8n builds for Shopify, and from December lead-response / CRM builds (GoHighLevel, HubSpot). Review AI-drafted workflows and our demos before clients see them. Own client calls: usually 1–3 short calls a week, scheduled within 24 hours. Everything else is written. Be the named specialist on our Upwork agency proposals, as a non-exclusive member. You keep your own profile and clients. Must have Hands
